num_kv_blocks_mean.unit: allocated GPU KV blocks per reported configuration
num_kv_blocks_mean.aggregation: Deduplicate equal capacities across the rank. The adapter reads num_gpu_blocks and requires one common capacity per timestamp; for homogeneous ranks this equals the mean.

ttft_p99_seconds.aggregation: Sum histogram bucket rates across the rank, then calculate the rank-level 99th percentile.

tpot_p99_seconds.aggregation: Sum histogram bucket rates across the rank, then calculate the rank-level 99th percentile.

generated_output_tokens_per_second.aggregation: Calculate each counter rate, then sum the rates across the rank.

running_requests.aggregation: Sum running requests across the rank.

waiting_requests.aggregation: Sum waiting requests across the rank.

kv_cache_usage_fraction.aggregation: Take the mean cache usage across the rank's reported series.

prefix_cache_hit_fraction.aggregation: Divide rank-wide hit rate by rank-wide lookup rate; omit ranks with no lookups.

prompt_tokens_per_request.aggregation: Divide rank-wide prompt-token rate by rank-wide request rate; omit ranks with no requests.

generated_tokens_per_request.aggregation: Divide rank-wide generated-token rate by rank-wide completed-request rate; omit ranks with no requests.

prefill_observations_per_second.aggregation: Calculate each counter rate, then sum the rates across the rank.

decode_observations_per_second.aggregation: Calculate each counter rate, then sum the rates across the rank.

prefill_decode_time_ratio.unit: prefill time divided by decode time
prefill_decode_time_ratio.aggregation: Divide rank-wide prefill-time rate by rank-wide decode-time rate; omit ranks with no decode time.
